steps: The Horizontal Milling Machine performs milling for 63 minutes, using a helical tool path at a speed of 1200 rpm to produce a finished machined component with a surface finish of Ra 0.8, starting from a milled part on the conveyor belt and resulting in the finished component on the same conveyor belt.

The CNC Turning Center performs CNC Turning on a lathed part from a conveyor belt for 84 minutes using a G-code program, 0.1 mm tool offsets, and a spindle speed of 1500 rpm, producing a finished machined component placed back onto the conveyor belt.

Using a Punch Press for 3 minutes, the Sheet Metal Punching operation transforms sheet metal from the conveyor belt into a finished sheet metal product by punching with a 10 mm punch size, a stroke speed of 30 spm, and a die alignment precision of 0.05 mm.

The Gear Shaping operation transforms a broached component into a 24-tooth spur gear using a Gear Shaper machine running at 200 rpm, processing for 53 minutes, with the input and output components transported on a conveyor belt.

On the Drill Press, perform a Drilling operation for 1 minute using a 6 mm drill bit with a spindle speed of 1000 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev to transform a Metal bar on the ConveyorBelt into a Drilled component on the ConveyorBelt.

The Wire EDM Cutting operation, performed on a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 35 minutes, uses a brass wire and electrical parameters of 50 V to cut a shaped part from a conveyor belt at a speed of 5 mm/min, resulting in a precision finished part placed back on the conveyor belt.

The Stewart Platform Mills performs Precision Milling on a Milled part from the ConveyorBelt for 20 minutes, using a flat end mill with a precision of 0.01 mm and active vibration damping, producing a Ground part placed back on the ConveyorBelt.
Using a Gear Shaper, perform Gear Shaping on a broached component to produce a shaped gear with 24 teeth of Spur type, operating at a shaping speed of 200 rpm, for 43 minutes.
Using a Laser Cutter with a laser power of 2000 W, a cutting speed of 10 mm/s, and nitrogen gas assist, the operation performs Laser Cutting on sheet metal for 43 minutes to produce cut sheet metal.

The Planer machine performs the Planing operation on a Milled part from the ConveyorBelt for 85 minutes, producing a Planed part with a Planing depth of 0.5 mm, a Feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and a Surface finish of Ra 1.6, which is then placed back on the ConveyorBelt.

The Planing operation smooths and flattens the surface of the Milled part taken from the ConveyorBelt using a Planer for 23 minutes, achieving a Planed part with a 0.5 mm Planing depth, a 0.2 mm/rev Feed rate, and a Surface finish of Ra 1.6, which is then placed back onto the ConveyorBelt.

On the Drill Press, a metal bar from the conveyor belt is drilled for 21 minutes using a 6 mm drill bit, a spindle speed of 1000 rpm, and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, resulting in a drilled component placed back on the conveyor belt.
Using a Bandsaw, the metal bar is cut through sawing for 10 minutes at a saw speed of 50 m/min with a bimetal blade, resulting in a lathed part with a cutting width of 1 mm.

The Hobbing Machine performs Gear Hobbing on a broached component for 77 minutes at a hobbing speed of 300 rpm, a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, and an involute gear profile, transforming it into a hobbied gear.

The Shaper machine performs the Shaping operation on a Milled part using a Flat tool with a stroke length of 100 mm and a shaping speed of 20 spm for 83 minutes, transforming the Milled part into a Shaped part, both transported via a ConveyorBelt.

The Grinding operation uses a Grinding Machine to grind a Planed part into a Ground part for 27 minutes using an Aluminum oxide grinding wheel at 1800 rpm with a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, with both input and output components transported on a ConveyorBelt.
Using Screw Machines, perform Screw Threading on a Lathed part for 35 minutes, creating a Screwed component with an M6 screw size and Metric thread type at a production rate of 500 units per hour.
The Hobbing Machine performs Gear Hobbing on a broached component for 18 minutes at a hobbing speed of 300 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev with an involute gear profile to produce a hobbied gear.

Using a Shaper machine for 44 minutes, the Milled part from the ConveyorBelt is transformed into a Shaped part on the ConveyorBelt through the Shaping operation, with a stroke length of 100 mm, a shaping speed of 20 spm, and a flat tool.

A vertical lathe performs vertical turning on a metal bar for 39 minutes at a rotation speed of 800 rpm using a carbide tool with a feed rate of 0.15 mm/rev, transforming the metal bar into a lathed part, which is then placed on a conveyor belt.

The metal bar from the conveyor belt undergoes turning on a vertical lathe for 97 minutes using a carbide tool at a rotation speed of 1200 rpm and a feed rate of 0.2 mm/rev, resulting in a lathed part placed in the mobile robot.

Using a Horizontal Milling Machine, perform Milling on a Milled part taken from a ConveyorBelt for 48 minutes at a speed of 800 rpm with a helical tool path to achieve a surface finish of 0.8 µm Ra, resulting in a Finished machined component placed on a MobileRobot.

Using a Drill Press, the operation of drilling transforms a metal bar from the conveyor belt into a drilled component placed onto a mobile robot, utilizing a 6 mm drill bit with a spindle speed of 1000 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev for 63 minutes.

Using a Wire EDM (Electrical Discharge Machine) for 75 minutes, a shaped part from the conveyor belt is precisely cut into a finished part using a brass wire, with electrical parameters set to 150 V and 10 A, and a cutting speed of 2 mm/min, resulting in the precision finished part being placed on a mobile robot.

The CNC Turning Center performs CNC Turning on a lathed part using a custom CNC program, 0.01 mm tool offsets, and a spindle speed of 1000 rpm for 72 minutes, transforming the lathed part into a finished machined component, which is then placed on the conveyor belt.
The Grinding operation uses a Grinding Machine to process a Planed part into a Ground part for 43 minutes with a CBN grinding wheel at a wheel speed of 2000 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev.

Using a Drill Press, a metal bar from the conveyor belt is drilled for 27 minutes with a 3 mm drill bit at a spindle speed of 1500 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev, resulting in a drilled component placed back on the conveyor belt.
